narrative.narrative: Clean-asset intake across 79 exchanges fell to 194.4 million dollars from 299.6 million dollars, equal to 0.0722 percent of the 269.4 billion dollars held on those venues. A positive pipe is dollars arriving on the venue, sell-side supply, and a negative pipe is dollars leaving, measured as the 24-hour change in holdings excluding each exchange's own token. Bitget sent out 56.5 million dollars, the largest venue outflow, while Bitstamp took in 296.3 million dollars and Binance took in 57.1 million dollars.
